entities.name: Streptococcus agalactiae RepB P13921
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P13921 RepB; 210 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Essential for plasmid replication; nicks the positive strand at the plasmid plus origin of replication.
Annotated for DNA binding, DNA topoisomerase activity, identical protein binding, and DNA replication.
GO cellular component annotation: extrachromosomal circular DNA; this indicates plasmid-associated localization, not a specific cellular compartment.
Pfam Rep_OBD domain (PF01719) detected at residues 1–129. Sequence-derived mass 24.25 kDa and pI 8.75.

entities.name: Plasmid DNA replication
observations: RepB is essential for plasmid replication and nicks the positive strand at the plus origin of replication.
